text:
alex: Heads-up — deploy-bot flagged a promotion for ingress-service chart v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 targeting eu-staging (22:00-23:00 window). Preflight reported a values collision across shards.

deploy-bot: [automated] PRELIGHT FAIL — values.hash mismatch: overlay `tenantOverlay.yaml` differs between shard-a and shard-b (ingress.service.port). Promotion blocked.

sara: Ack. Is this the same overlay pattern we saw earlier where shard-specific hotfixes landed post-branch-cut?

maria: Looks like it. shard-b has a hotfix override (svcPort: 8081) merged after the staging branch was cut. shard-a still expects 8080.

alex: My preference: manual pin for eu-staging and reconcile the overlays before re-running the canary. Rolling back the chart risks terminating long-lived sessions.

jon: If we proceed despite mismatch, what's the realistic impact on clients? Any schema-level incompat?

sara: It’s a runtime port mismatch — some pods would get 8081, services expect 8080. Could cause 502s. Not worth the risk for staging.

maria: Proposed plan: (1) pin the promotion, (2) open a tiny release-note entry "values overlay mismatch — reconciling", (3) fix the shard-b override in a PR and re-run tests, (4) ask deploy-bot to requeue.

alex: I'll open the PR to revert the hotfix into the canary branch and include a changelog entry. If CI passes, we re-queue.

sara: If we need a temporary mitigation, we can do a targeted canary at 5-10% traffic after confirming the reconciled values. We'll also set a fast rollback hook. Example command for manual canary run:

```bash
helm upgrade --install ingress-service ./charts/ingress-service 
  --set overrides=@reconciled-overrides.yaml 
  --wait --timeout 5m 
  --set canary.enabled=true 
  --set canary.weight=10
```

maria: I've added the release-note draft and linked the PR. Also pinged platform to validate env-level service selectors after the promote.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused by manual hold: reason `values-merge-conflict`. To resume, run `/deploy-bot resume 4967890123`. :pause_button:

jon: Added a short postmortem checklist to the release notes: verify overlay merging, validate svcPort matrix, confirm canary traffic shaping.

sara: Thanks — will follow up once PR is green. Requeue when ready. :thumbsup:
